description: evidence.nu base detection silently failed: (1) git log --grep pattern 'fabro.<run-id>:' never matched checkpoint subjects 'fabro(<run-id>): ...' because a regex '.' ate the '(' and the pattern lacked the ')' before ':' — use --fixed-strings with literal 'fabro(<run-id>):'; (2) run_id from 'parse --regex | get -o id' is a list<string>, interpolating it into a string renders '[id]' — use 'get -o id.0'. Symptom: NO RUN BASE, empty diff sections, misleading evidence.
resolution: Fixed both in evidence.nu: fixed-string grep + id.0 cell path; smoke run detects base 805acb3 and emits the real 192-line run diff

content: Order evidence output tail-critical; end with an integrity summary line; keep total sections compact

description: Evidence pipe misdiagnosed for 4 cycles: assumed TAIL-anchored embed (~25 lines/1KB); actually HEAD-anchored ~300 chars at default compact fidelity (measured: capture cut mid-line at char ~298, four identical cuts). CAVEAT: sandbox runs bundle the manifest (graph attrs + prompt templates) at run start — mid-run edits to workflow.fabro/reviewer.md may not apply until the NEXT run; scripts (evidence.nu) are read live from the worktree each visit.
resolution: reviewer node now sets fidelity=summary:high in workflow.fabro; evidence.nu rewritten critical-first (integrity header + seed-work file list within first ~281 chars, complete seed-work diff next, churn counts and worktree last); reviewer.md pipe description corrected. Verified: 15/15 deterministic runs, first 293 bytes carry base + integrity + exact seed-work file list.

name: raw-capture-not-line-join
description: Capture external command output in nu via 'do { cmd } | complete | get stdout' (raw string), not 'cmd | str join' — the lines-split/rejoin round-trip injected a stray newline mid-line once (observed, never reproduced); raw capture rules the class out. Supersedes tail-critical ordering advice (mx-8f3040): order evidence HEAD-critical instead.

Parallel edit_file calls to the SAME file in one batch silently clobber each other: each reports success but only the last write survives (lost a strconv import and two run() call-site updates; caught later by go vet). Applies to any agent editing one file with multiple edits.
resolution: Issue edit_file calls to the same file strictly sequentially, one per batch; verify with gofmt/go vet/go test after each edit round.

content: Slack channels are configured in THREE independent places, each with its own purpose: (1) project.toml [run.notifications.<route>].slack.channel - lifecycle notifications per run route; (2) workflow.toml [run.notifications.<route>] - workflow-level routes riding the workflow's own settings; (3) server settings server.integrations.slack.default_channel - THE interview channel where HITL questions are posted (server-side, needs restart). A wrong channel in ANY of them fails with the same channel_not_found warning. Verified 2026-08-27: all three carried the phantom #fabro-reviews; fixed to #dev-fabro, first successful notification delivered (run 01M129B2MYVX1D8NB7PPF593E9).
